final: SELECT AVG(first_measure), AVG(second_measure), AVG(third_measure) FROM (SELECT avg_albumin_minus_protein AS first_measure, avg_aptt_minus_pt AS second_measure, avg_aptt_minus_pt - (SELECT AVG(sex_avg_aptt_minus_pt) FROM (SELECT SEX, AVG(sex_patient_avg_aptt_minus_pt) AS sex_avg_aptt_minus_pt FROM (SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, AVG(1.0 * (l.APTT - l.PT)) AS sex_patient_avg_aptt_minus_pt FROM Laboratory l JOIN Patient p ON p.ID = l.ID GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX) GROUP BY SEX) WHERE sex_avg_aptt_minus_pt IS NOT NULL) AS third_measure FROM (SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, AVG(1.0 * (l.ALB - l.TP)) AS avg_albumin_minus_protein, AVG(1.0 * (l.APTT - l.PT)) AS avg_aptt_minus_pt FROM Laboratory l JOIN Patient p ON p.ID = l.ID GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX) WHERE avg_aptt_minus_pt > (SELECT AVG(sex_avg_aptt_minus_pt) FROM (SELECT SEX, AVG(sex_patient_avg_aptt_minus_pt) AS sex_avg_aptt_minus_pt FROM (SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, AVG(1.0 * (l.APTT - l.PT)) AS sex_patient_avg_aptt_minus_pt FROM Laboratory l JOIN Patient p ON p.ID = l.ID GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX) GROUP BY SEX) WHERE sex_avg_aptt_minus_pt IS NOT NULL))
